name: Arkansas

form.name: Application for a Permit to Drill
form.notes: Two-page PDF read in full. Purpose: Original, Amendment, Renewal, Re-entry. Type of well: crude oil, natural gas, CBM, brine supply, Class II, Class V, UNGS, other. Frac-related items (casing, cement, treating pressure, water source) are asked only if the completion will be fractured. Needs a certified lease plat by a land surveyor. Companion forms: 1 Organization Report, 2A pits notice, 2B pits closure, 3 completion, 3A frac report. Agency-use box: issue date, expiration date, permit no., API no.

api_number.n: API number on each permit in the weekly report; wellid in the GIS layer (9 digits); Form 2 has an API No. box

permit_number.n: Permit number in the weekly report (typed with mistakes: one number served three wells) and permitnumberstring

well_name.n: Well name in the weekly report (not unique); wellname and wellnumber in the layer

lease_name.n: Form 2: "Description of Drilling Unit or Lease (if uncontrolled or wildcat)"

operator_name.n: Operator on each permit in the weekly report; operatorname in the layer

operator_id.n: Form 2 asks the name only; Form 1 Organization Report not read

bond.n: Not on Form 2; financial assurance rules not read

county.n: County on each permit in the weekly report (the API number's county place is steadier); countyname in the layer

district.n: Not a Form 2 field (form is mailed to the El Dorado Regional Office)

field_pool.n: Field printed in the weekly report; fieldname and poolnamestring in the layer

surface_latlon.n: Latitude and longitude printed in the weekly report; coordinates_latitude/longitude in the layer

bottom_hole_loc.n: Form 2 asks PBHL footages; layer coordinates_type not checked for bottom-hole rows

lateral_path.n: Form 2 asks no survey or path

elevation.n: Only for Fayetteville Shale wells: lowest ground elevation within 1 mile; layer has no value

well_type.n: welltype, welltypedescription in the GIS layer (stale since late 2025); the weekly report has no well type

work_type.n: Weekly report prints the Form 2 Purpose (renewal, amend, re-entry) under the permit number; an original prints none

well_direction.n: Form 2: proposed well Vertical, Directional or Horizontal

proposed_depth_md.n: Proposed depth printed in the weekly report (MD or TVD not stated); Form 2 asks MD and TVD

lateral_length.n: Not asked; only derivable from SHL and PBHL footages

target_formation.n: Zone printed in the weekly report; Form 2: 'Formation you propose to complete in'

casing_program.n: Casing depth TVD/MD and API grade, but only if the completion will be fractured

cement_program.n: Top of production casing cement and compressive strength, only if fractured

pit_waste.n: Form 2A (pits notice) and Form 2B (closure); Form 2 asks if oil-based mud will be used

water.n: Form 2: proposed source of frac water; no volume asked

fracture_plan.n: Form 2: will completion be fractured, max surface treating pressure; Form 3A report later

spacing_unit.n: Form 2: acres in lease, acres in drilling unit, distances to unit and lease boundary

spacing_exception.n: Form 2: attach exceptional location permit or application

mineral_owner.n: Certificate says operator holds a valid lease, farmout or agreement; no owner named

fee.n: Rule 15 CAR 275-201 (search summary) says a permit fee goes with the application; amount not seen

date_approved.n: Weekly report names the week of issue, not the day; Form 2 has an Issue Date box (agency use)

date_expires.n: Expiration Date box (agency use) on Form 2

spud_date.n: Weekly report prints the planned start date, not a spud date; layer has no spud date

status.n: wellstatus, wellstatusdescription, wellstatusdate (PR, PA, EX, PW...)

plat_image.n: Certified lease plat is required; a Well File Cabinet (DocuWare) is listed on the site, not opened

logs.n: Well Log Search and Well Log Cabinet pages exist on the site; not opened

production_link.n: Well lookup has a Production tab; exports to Excel; Build-a-Query production report

sources.license: Arkansas GIS Office; accuracy varies, no warranty
activity_types: well status only (Producing, Plugged and Abandoned, Permitted Well, Spudded, Expired Permit...)
sources.tested: layer?f=json: 200, 14.8 KB, 49 fields, point geometry, max 500 records per query, formats JSON/geoJSON/PBF. One statistics query: 38,245 wells (16,570 PR, 16,061 PA, 3,385 A, 1,233 EX, 8 PW, 7 SP). wellstatusdate is a text field (m/d/yyyy) and there is no permit-issue or spud date, so permits cannot be counted by month from it. The layer is stale: its newest permit number is 48449, from late 2025. It checks the weekly lists (291 of its 294 permit numbers from 48136 to 48447 are on them) and cannot replace them.

sources.name: Permit and Completion Reports (one report a Friday since 2019-01-04: Form 2 permits, Form 3 completions and recompletions, Form 11 and 12 plugging; workbooks from mid-2020, PDFs before)
columns: purpose word under the number (renewal, amend, re-entry; none on an original)
week ending date (in the section title)
activity_types: drilling permit (Form 2): original, amendment, renewal, re-entry
sources.tested: Read in full 2026-11-01. The page is an ASP.NET form: choosing a year is a postback that returns the whole tree of months and files, and every report also has a plain static address (/Data/Wipe/<year>/<mm-Month>/<file>) that needs no cookie. 403 reports from 2019-01-04 to 2026-10-23 (340 Excel workbooks from mid-2020, 63 PDFs before), one a Friday; five Fridays have none (2019-11-29, 2024-01-19, 2024-10-04, 2026-01-30, 2026-05-08). Each has eight sections, North and South Arkansas each; the Form 2 permit lists carry the fields above. In the workbooks 274 permits print no purpose (originals), 33 renewals, 22 amendments, 22 re-entries. About 600 requests to the site with the plain automated agent and no refusal; the server drops about one connection in ten (cause not known: the server or the research proxy). The week is the only date: a report names the week, not the day.

sources.name: Lease & Well Data lookup (search by permit/API, field, county, well name or operator) and Build-a-Query production report
sources.tested: Page GET: HTTP 200, 56 KB (an ASP.NET form, no search run). Page says each well shows Location details, History, Perforations, Stimulations, Production, IMIT and Inspections tabs, and every report exports to Excel (.xls). The Build-a-Query page (data/querybuild.aspx, 200) filters production by year, company, county, field, section, well status, well type and zone. Date fields of the History tab not verified.

grade_reason: The weekly Permit and Completion Reports are free workbooks (PDFs before mid-2020), one a Friday since January 2019, listing every Form 2 drilling permit with its operator, county, field, location, proposed depth, zone and a printed purpose (original, renewal, amendment, re-entry). Held to B, not A: the date is the week of issue, not the day; there is no well type, so disposal, brine and carbon-storage wells sit among the new permits; five weeks are missing; and the files are reached through an ASP.NET page. The GIS wells layer has well types but no permit date and has not been updated since late 2025. Updated 2026-11-01: a producer reads the reports each week; new plus re-entry permits account for 308 of the 312 permit numbers assigned from 2019 to 2025, and exactly for 2024 and 2025.
producer_plan: Built: d11_nat_ar.py. Posts the year to the reports page (form state from the first GET, no cookie), reads the file names from the tree and GETs each report by its static address (xlsx since mid-2020; PDFs through pdftotext before), 3 s apart, up to four tries a file. Only the two Form 2 sections are read. A week counts in the month that holds its Wednesday. Bands: no purpose printed = new; renewal or amend = amend; re-entry = redrill; any other word = other; inj, rework and fluid are null (no well type on the list). The county comes from the API number's county place (the printed county cell moves); the API number is read only for that, never kept. A weekly run reads the last 14 months (62 requests, about 4 minutes) and takes older months from the committed file. Limits: seven repeated listings (new up to 2% high), five missing weeks (KNOWN_MISSING), permit numbers typed with mistakes (never a key). Checks are in NOTES_D11.md.
privacy_notes: Form 2 asks the send-to street address, e-mail and phone; none of these are in the weekly reports or the GIS layer. The reports and the layer list operators; seven listings since 2019 are a person's or a family firm's and are never named.
